svg.desc: Port Said Marina Complex LOCATION Port said, Egypt CLIENT Port Said Governorate COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2015 2 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Project Overview This project involved the development of a yacht marina and a tourist complex built over an area of 350 acres in Port Said. The work scope included preparing the master plan, architectural design, and project management. Responsibilities also covered supervising the execution and conducting site inspections to ensure that all construction and tourism-related facilities, including the marina infrastructure, were completed to standard.
